sources.title: PoolFormer - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview The PoolFormer model was proposed in MetaFormer is Actually What You Need for Vision by Sea AI Labs. Instead of designing complicated token mixer to achieve SOTA performance, the target of this work is to demonstrate the competence of transformer models largely stem from the general architecture MetaFormer.

sources.title: Poolformer: Recurrent Networks with Pooling for Long-Sequence Modeling
sources.snippet: We propose Poolformer, a sequence-to-sequence model that replaces self-attention layers with recurrent layers, and that makes use of pooling to reduce the sequence length. We evaluate our model on raw audio, which naturally features long sequence lengths. Chapter 2 contains all the theoretical background.

sources.title: DeepLearning/model/PoolFormer at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Surprisingly, the resulted model PoolFormer consistently outperforms the DeiT and ResMLP as shown in (b), which well supports that MetaFormer is actually what we need to achieve competitive performance. RSB-ResNet in (b) means the results are from "ResNet Strikes Back" where ResNet is trained with improved training procedure for 300 epochs.
